notes: Fresh-node adoption now waits up to 90 seconds for the Node API service to become healthy before Manager attempts verification.
Manager retries the authenticated API verification for a further 30 seconds, preventing a successful installation being reported as failed while Uvicorn is still binding port 8000.
If the service genuinely cannot start, the progress screen now includes recent systemd status and journal diagnostics.
A successful retry with the same Node ID replaces the stale Manager API token and clears the repeated 401 Unauthorized polling errors.
The v0.18.0 background progress display and safe retry behaviour are preserved.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.5.
